subtitle: How One Chemist Dreamed a Nation of Laboratories

panels.shot: sweeping low-angle wide of Bhatnagar amid ghostly silhouettes of future labs
panels.action: Shanti Swaroop Bhatnagar stands in a vast, dim hall, blueprints in hand, while translucent visions of laboratories in Delhi, Pune, Mysore, Dhanbad and Lucknow rise around him like distant fortresses of glass and steel.

dialogue.text: In a land breaking from empire, Shanti Swaroop Bhatnagar dares a new conquest: not of territory, but of laboratories, binding Indian science into a single, restless network.

i18n.hi: साम्राज्य की पकड़ टूटती जमीन पर, शांति स्वरूप भटनागर नई जीत चुनते हैं: ज़मीन नहीं, लैबों की, जो भारतीय विज्ञान को एक बेचैन जाल में बाँधती है.

panels.shot: slow push-in on a desk piled with reports dated 1942
panels.action: In a wartime office in Lahore, Bhatnagar leans over heavy CSIR founding files, the map of India pinned behind him, rail lines and industrial towns inked with careful marks.

dialogue.text: 1942. As war strains supplies and industry, a new body is born: the Council of Scientific and Industrial Research, with chemist Shanti Swaroop Bhatnagar as its first Director-General.

i18n.hi: 1942. जंग से रसद और उद्योग पर दबाव है, तभी जन्म लेती है नई संस्था: काउंसिल ऑफ साइंटिफिक एंड इंडस्ट्रियल रिसर्च, जिसके पहले डायरेक्टर-जनरल हैं रसायनविद शांति स्वरूप भटनागर.

panels.shot: extreme close-up on an open monograph beside government files
panels.action: On his desk lies his 1935 book on magnetochemistry, open beside government minutes, his fingers hovering between dense equations and typed resolutions.

dialogue.text: He is not only an administrator. His work in magnetochemistry has earned global respect. Now the state asks him to turn personal research into national capacity.

i18n.hi: वह सिर्फ अफसर नहीं हैं. मैग्नेटोकेमिस्ट्री में उनकी मेहनत दुनिया भर में नाम कमा चुकी है. अब राज्य उनसे कहता है: निजी रिसर्च को राष्ट्रीय ताकत में बदलो.

panels.shot: medium shot as he addresses a small committee around a table
panels.action: Bhatnagar stands at the head of a wooden conference table, gesturing to a hand-drawn chart that links universities, industries and proposed laboratories.

dialogue.text: The founding records show his early argument clearly: scattered university departments are not enough. India needs laboratories focused on food, fuel, drugs and physics.

i18n.hi: स्थापना के कागज़ साफ बताते हैं उनका शुरुआती तर्क: बिखरे हुए यूनिवर्सिटी डिपार्टमेंट काफी नहीं. भारत को चाहिए लैब्स जो खाने, ईंधन, दवाओं और फिज़िक्स पर केंद्रित हों.

panels.shot: bird's-eye of the CSIR office in late colonial Delhi
panels.action: In Delhi, ceiling fans turn above clerks typing, while Bhatnagar moves between desks, reviewing letters from provincial governments and industrial firms.

dialogue.text: He begins in the constraints of empire. CSIR’s wartime reports track modest schemes and applied projects. But behind them, he sketches a larger weave of national laboratories.

i18n.hi: वह शुरुआत करता है साम्राज्य की जकड़ में. सीएसआईआर की जंगकालीन रिपोर्टें छोटे-मोटे प्लान और लागू प्रोजेक्ट दिखाती हैं. पर इनके पीछे वो राष्ट्रीय लैबों का बड़ा जाल रेखता है.

panels.shot: low-angle two-shot suggestion with an unseen leader across a desk
panels.action: In a sparse office after independence, Bhatnagar sits across from an unseen figure, the tricolour just visible, as he points to a plan for a National Physical Laboratory in Delhi.

dialogue.speaker: shanti_swaroop_bhatnagar
dialogue.text: If industry is our engine, we must build the workshops of measurement first.

i18n.hi: अगर उद्योग हमारा इंजन है, तो पहले नाप-तोल की कार्यशालाएँ खड़ी करनी होंगी.

panels.shot: epic wide of a construction site in Delhi
panels.action: Bhatnagar stands at the edge of a dusty construction site, watching skeletal frames of the future National Physical Laboratory rise, workers hauling concrete and steel under a harsh sun.

dialogue.text: The National Physical Laboratory in Delhi is among the first pillars. In annual reports, its promise is clear: standards, precision, and a home for Indian physics and metrology.

i18n.hi: दिल्ली की नेशनल फिज़िकल लैबोरेटरी शुरुआती स्तंभों में है. सालाना रिपोर्टों में उसका वादा साफ है: मानक, सूक्ष्म माप और भारतीय फिज़िक्स व मेट्रोलॉजी का अपना घर.

panels.shot: medium shot inside a bare lab hall with minimal equipment
panels.action: Inside a newly built hall, a few basic instruments sit on long benches, while young scientists in simple coats look around with mixed excitement and uncertainty; Bhatnagar walks among them.

dialogue.text: The buildings arrive before full strength. Records admit the gaps: staff are few, equipment is limited, and foreign instruments still dominate. These are beginnings, not finished triumphs.

i18n.hi: इमारतें तो खड़ी हो जाती हैं, ताकत अभी कम है. रजिस्टर खुद मानते हैं: स्टाफ कम, मशीनें सीमित, विदेशी औज़ारों का दबदबा. ये शुरुआतें हैं, फाइनल फतह नहीं.

panels.shot: dissolve-style composition linking maps of Pune, Mysore and Dhanbad
panels.action: A large wall map shows Pune, Mysore and Dhanbad circled in ink, with sketched icons for chemical flasks, grain silos and coal seams drawn beside them; Bhatnagar pins another note.

dialogue.text: From Delhi the idea spreads. In Pune, a National Chemical Laboratory. In Mysore, a Central Food Technological Research Institute. In Dhanbad, a Central Fuel Research Institute.

i18n.hi: दिल्ली से विचार फैलता है. पुणे में नेशनल केमिकल लैबोरेटरी. मैसूर में सेंट्रल फूड टेक्नोलॉजिकल रिसर्च इंस्टीट्यूट. धनबाद में सेंट्रल फ्यूल रिसर्च इंस्टीट्यूट.

panels.shot: wide shot of the emerging NCL campus in Pune
panels.action: In Pune, Bhatnagar visits the half-finished National Chemical Laboratory, walking along a path flanked by new buildings, with young chemists trailing behind him carrying notebooks.

dialogue.text: At Pune, chemistry is tied directly to industry. CSIR files show programmes on catalysis, materials and process development, aimed at helping Indian factories adapt and innovate.

i18n.hi: पुणे में रसायन सीधे उद्योग से जुड़ता है. सीएसआईआर की फाइलें कैटलिसिस, नए मटेरियल और प्रोसेस डेवलपमेंट के प्रोग्राम दिखाती हैं, ताकि भारतीय फैक्टरियाँ खुद को ढालें और नवाचार करें.

panels.shot: interior medium shot of a food laboratory in Mysore
panels.action: In Mysore’s CFTRI, Bhatnagar peers at jars of grains and oils on shelves while a scientist demonstrates a small machine for processing food under controlled conditions.

dialogue.text: At Mysore, food technology takes centre stage. The institute’s mission: study storage, preservation and processing, so India’s harvests feed more people, more reliably.

i18n.hi: मैसूर में मंच पर खाने की टेक्नोलॉजी है. इंस्टीट्यूट का काम: भंडारण, बचाव और प्रोसेसिंग की पढ़ाई, ताकि भारत की फसलें ज़्यादा लोगों तक, ज़्यादा भरोसे से पहुँचें.

panels.shot: low-angle shot of a coal yard near Dhanbad with lab building in background
panels.action: Near Dhanbad, heaps of coal dominate the foreground, while the modest Central Fuel Research Institute building stands beyond; Bhatnagar watches miners walking past towards the town.

dialogue.text: Fuel is another frontier. The Central Fuel Research Institute at Dhanbad studies coal and combustion, seeking ways to use domestic resources more efficiently in a growing economy.

i18n.hi: ईंधन एक और मोर्चा है. धनबाद का सेंट्रल फ्यूल रिसर्च इंस्टीट्यूट कोयला और दहन का अध्ययन करता है, ताकि बढ़ती अर्थव्यवस्था में घरेलू संसाधन ज्यादा कुशलता से जलें.

panels.shot: medium shot in a Lucknow office with medical diagrams
panels.action: In Lucknow, Bhatnagar sits at a table strewn with pharmacological charts and plant samples, as he listens to a physician explaining urgent needs for new drugs.

dialogue.text: The Central Drug Research Institute in Lucknow opens another path. Its agenda: study medicines, test compounds, and slowly build indigenous capacity in pharmaceuticals and therapeutics.

i18n.hi: लखनऊ का सेंट्रल ड्रग रिसर्च इंस्टीट्यूट नई राह खोलता है. उसका एजेंडा: दवाओं की पढ़ाई, यौगिकों की जाँच, और धीरे-धीरे देसी फ़ार्मा और उपचार की क्षमता बनाना.

panels.shot: slow push-in on Bhatnagar addressing a gathering of young scientists
panels.action: Bhatnagar stands before a mixed audience of young scientists from different labs, his hand raised, a simple blackboard behind him bearing a web of laboratory names linked together.

dialogue.speaker: shanti_swaroop_bhatnagar
dialogue.text: Our strength will lie not in one great institute, but in many talking to each other.

i18n.hi: हमारी ताकत एक महान संस्थान में नहीं, कई संस्थानों की आपसी बातचीत में होगी.

panels.shot: documentary-style close-up on CSIR annual report pages
panels.action: A hand—Bhatnagar’s—turns pages of a CSIR annual report, showing tables of projects and a diagram of the national laboratory scheme spreading across the country.

dialogue.text: CSIR reports from 1942 to the mid-1950s chart the expansion. Each laboratory adds projects, collaborations, and training programmes, slowly knitting science into industry and administration.

i18n.hi: 1942 से पचास के दशक के बीच की सीएसआईआर रिपोर्टें फैलाव दर्ज करती हैं. हर लैब नए प्रोजेक्ट, साझेदारी और ट्रेनिंग प्रोग्राम जोड़ती है, जो विज्ञान को धीरे-धीरे उद्योग और शासन में बुनते हैं.

panels.shot: medium shot of him alone, late evening in his office
panels.action: Late at night, Bhatnagar sits alone at his desk, his face lined with fatigue, a poem draft by his side and a stack of budget requests before him.

dialogue.text: The memoirs remember him as a poet and chemist, but these years also make him a negotiator. He balances ambition with money, staff and equipment, fighting for each institute’s survival.

i18n.hi: संस्मरण उन्हें शायर और रसायनविद याद रखते हैं, पर ये साल उन्हें सौदागर भी बनाते हैं. वह सपनों को पैसे, स्टाफ और मशीनों से तौलते हैं, हर इंस्टीट्यूट की जान के लिए जूझते हैं.

panels.shot: reflective wide shot of several laboratory buildings in montage
panels.action: A sweeping montage shows the façades of NPL, NCL, CFTRI, CFRI and CDRI under different skies, each with scientists entering and leaving, bicycles and buses in motion.

dialogue.text: Later historians debate these choices. Did CSIR’s labs build independent technology, or adapt foreign models? The archives answer cautiously: they laid foundations and momentum, not instant mastery.

i18n.hi: बाद के इतिहासकार इन फैसलों पर बहस करते हैं. क्या सीएसआईआर की लैबों ने खुद की तकनीक गढ़ी, या विदेशी मॉडल ढाले? रिकॉर्ड संभल कर कहते हैं: उन्होंने नींव और रफ्तार दी, तुरंत उस्तादी नहीं.

panels.shot: close-up of Bhatnagar looking out over Delhi, slightly aged
panels.action: An older Bhatnagar stands on a terrace overlooking Delhi’s growing skyline, the distant dome of a laboratory just visible, his expression thoughtful, almost questioning.

dialogue.text: By the early 1950s, his health is failing, but the system he helped design is moving. It will be judged, revised and challenged, yet it endures as a frame for Indian scientific work.

i18n.hi: पचास की शुरुआत तक उनकी सेहत ढल रही है, पर उनकी गढ़ी व्यवस्था चल पड़ी है. इसकी कसौटी होगी, इसे बदला और ललकारा जाएगा, फिर भी भारतीय वैज्ञानिक काम की चौखट बनी रहती है.

panels.shot: final wide shot of interconnected lab buildings linked by glowing lines
panels.action: In a symbolic view of India at night, small lights mark the laboratories at Delhi, Pune, Mysore, Dhanbad and Lucknow, connected by faint luminous lines, with Bhatnagar’s silhouette fading at the edge.

dialogue.text: His true legacy is not a single famous discovery, but a network of places where discoveries could happen—an unfinished, shared workshop through which a new nation learns to make its own tools.

i18n.hi: उसकी असली विरासत कोई एक मशहूर खोज नहीं, बल्कि वे जगहें हैं जहाँ खोजें हो सकती थीं—एक अधूरी, साझी कार्यशाला, जिसमें नई राष्ट्र अपनी औज़ार खुद बनाना सीखती है.

subtitle_i18n.en: How One Chemist Dreamed a Nation of Laboratories
subtitle_i18n.hi: एक रसायनविद का सपना: लैबों से भरा हिंदुस्तान
